section_summary: Complete overhaul of Nairobi's transport system including roads, rail, and public transport
section_content: We will invest KES 200 billion in transport infrastructure over 5 years. This includes completing the Nairobi Expressway, expanding commuter rail, and developing a comprehensive BRT system. Every major road will be rehabilitated and new bypasses constructed to decongest the city.

section_summary: Construction of 100,000 affordable housing units across Nairobi
section_content: Housing is a basic right. We will partner with private developers to construct 100,000 affordable housing units. Special focus on low-income areas with mortgage facilities at 5% interest rate. We will also upgrade informal settlements with proper infrastructure.

section_summary: Establishment of comprehensive healthcare facilities in every sub-county
section_content: Healthcare is not a privilege but a right. We will establish 24-hour hospitals in every sub-county, equip them with modern facilities, and ensure adequate staffing. NHIF coverage will be expanded to cover all Nairobi residents.

section_summary: Creation of 500,000 jobs through various initiatives
section_content: Our youth unemployment crisis requires urgent action. We will create 500,000 jobs through infrastructure projects, ICT hubs, agricultural programs, and support for SMEs. Every ward will have a youth employment center.

section_summary: Vocational training and skills development for market-relevant skills
section_content: Skills are the currency of the future. We will establish 50 vocational training centers across Nairobi offering courses in ICT, construction, hospitality, and entrepreneurship. Partnerships with industry will ensure curriculum relevance.

section_summary: KES 50 billion fund to support small and medium enterprises
section_content: Small businesses are the backbone of our economy. We will establish a KES 50 billion fund providing low-interest loans to SMEs. Business incubation centers will be established in every constituency to support startups.

section_summary: Support for urban agriculture and food security
section_content: Food security is national security. We will promote urban farming, support agricultural cooperatives, and establish markets for farm produce. Cold storage facilities will be built to reduce post-harvest losses.

section_summary: Comprehensive social safety net for vulnerable populations
section_content: No one should be left behind. We will expand cash transfer programs, establish universal health coverage, and provide social pensions for the elderly. Persons with disabilities will receive special support and protection.

section_summary: Financial inclusion and economic opportunities for women
section_content: When women thrive, economies grow. We will establish women's enterprise funds, provide access to credit, and ensure women's participation in government procurement. Women will own 30% of all government contracts.
